findings.evidence: Third Parties: You may register for other services from our Platforms which are offered by third parties. If you opt in to any of these third party services, we may collect additional information requested by this third party and pass this information, together with all other registration information (including personal information), to that third party. Use of your information by a third party will be governed by that third party’s terms of service and privacy policy.
findings.rationale: The policy does not specify sharing of IP addresses and device IDs with Unity Ads, but mentions sharing with third parties in a generic manner.
